title: Documentation, UI/help and agent guidance for the removal of per-turn gating: remove every gated-control mention and describe Work Tracking & Execution Observability
outcome: Every current TermAl document, UI and help string, skill and agent-facing guide matches the final removal implementation (w-3fe8f4472e5d). The user-facing name is "Work Tracking & Execution Observability", with project-level ON/OFF. The docs describe ordinary work sessions, assignments and claims, non-blocking execution, source and test evidence, and acceptance evaluation, with no turn-admission prerequisite. Retired gated-control descriptions, onboarding, config instructions and obsolete links or pages are removed, not renamed. Historical incident and evidence records stay untouched.
acceptance: An audit of the whole repository (literal 'gated control', 'turn-gated', 'turn gating', admission/begin/grant prerequisites, and synonymous old semantics) lists every match, with each one removed, rewritten to the final behaviour, or justified as historical or immutable.

README.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/features/engram-project-reset.md, docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md, docs/host-architecture.md, docs/project-status.md, docs/features/supervised-pilot-onboarding.md, the shipped/CLI-MCP/reset/onboarding docs, the UI/help strings and the skills describe only the final implementation, using the agreed terminology, and claim no evidence capability that the removal release has not actually delivered.

Edits to AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md follow the repository's exact-wording rule for instruction and authority files: both coordinators' concurrence on the exact wording, Greg sent the wording and its consequence, and a final-diff audit recorded before landing. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md stay identical in content where they are meant to.
Current project memories that describe gated control as current behaviour are revised or retired so that future agents do not restore it; historical records are not rewritten.
The documentation lands together with, or immediately after, the w-3fe8f4472e5d removal release, and its text is checked against that release's final code.

completion.summary: Current docs describe the final removal: no turn-admission prerequisite, and the retired gated-control text is removed, rewritten or marked historical. On master 7f8d1b63, gated by test-78f5f61f. Limits are stated on the closing note.
